kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنذئف (form VII)
# أَنْذَئِفُ (ʔanḏaʔifu) /ʔan.ða.ʔi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# أَنْذَئِفَ (ʔanḏaʔifa) /ʔan.ða.ʔi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# أَنْذَئِفْ (ʔanḏaʔif) /ʔan.ða.ʔif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
